title: Who is on what: the app's people put on things (accounts, sites, classes), with a role each
about: The team page of an app whose people see only what they belong to: a link table holds a row per person and thing (the person's account id, the thing's id, a role). It lists each thing with the people on it, flags things nobody is on, and lets the owner put someone on a thing (picked by name from the people who signed up) or take them off. It is what an access rule WHERE <col> IN (SELECT <thing> FROM <link table> WHERE <person> = :user_id) reads. Give it to the owner (FOR owner) or admins.

table.about: the link table (a row per person and thing)

things.about: the table of the things people are put on

person.about: the link column with the person's account id

thing.about: the link column with the thing's id

name.about: the things column with each one's name

role.about: the link column with the person's role on it (optional)

roles.about: the roles to choose from (a list)

label.about: what a thing is, as a heading (Account, Site)

data.{{key}}_links: SELECT * FROM {{table}} ORDER BY created LIMIT 2000
data.{{key}}_things: SELECT id, {{name}} AS sa_name FROM {{things}} ORDER BY {{name}} LIMIT 500

let.{{key}}_who: =v => { const p = ({{key}}_people || []).find(x => String(x.id) === String(v)); return p ? (p.name || p.email) : 'Someone who left'; }
let.{{key}}_rows: =({{key}}_things || []).map(t => { const on = ({{key}}_links || []).filter(l => String(l[{{thing|json}}]) === String(t.id)); return {id: t.id, name: t.sa_name, n: on.length, people: on.map(l => {{key}}_who(l[{{person|json}}]) + ({{role|json}} && l[{{role|json}}] ? ' (' + l[{{role|json}}] + ')' : '')).join(', ') || 'Nobody yet'}; })
let.{{key}}_list: =({{key}}_links || []).map(l => ({id: l.id, who: {{key}}_who(l[{{person|json}}]), what: (({{key}}_things || []).find(t => String(t.id) === String(l[{{thing|json}}])) || {}).sa_name || '—', role: {{role|json}} ? l[{{role|json}}] : null}))

col.empty: Add the first one, then put people on it.

card.text: Only people who have signed up to the app can be picked; send them its link first.
